items.title: Oct 3 peak at 7.33 M: first token in the peak minutes
items.text: At 7.33 M (0.92x of production's real load), six runs passed 1-7 of 15 minutes (median 3-4); 6.50 M passes 15/15. In minutes 0-3, device KV fills on the hot ranks and requests queue. Outside that burst, the median request loses about equal time to the queue, to tokenization and to tool-call output that our stack holds back. Prompt passes fill 52-68% of GPU time, and each one stops decode on both GPUs of its engine. Requests with images tokenize their text twice (1.6-2.9 s median); a bit-exact fix is in build. Scored on the first streamed chunk, as production seems to score, the same runs pass 9-13 of 15. That definition needs an owner decision.

items.title: Decode saturates per rank at high concurrency
items.text: Per-request decode falls from 135 tok/s at 1-4 requests per rank to 62 at 13-16; a rank's total decode flattens near 870-1,000 tok/s. The draft model gets 3.5 tokens accepted per step on real traffic. A batch-adaptive draft block would not pay (closed).
